summary: The only FDA documents available in paperclip for NDA215244 (Forzinity/elamipretide injection, Stealth BioTherapeutics, accelerated approval 2025 for Barth syndrome) are the Complete Response Letter (2025-05-15), the accelerated approval letter (2025), and the label. The standard review documents that would describe an advisory committee (Summary Review, CDTL/Cross-Discipline review, Medical Review, Office Director memo) are not present in paperclip. None of the three available documents mentions an advisory committee, vote, panel, or AdComm meeting; searches for 'Advisory Committee', 'committee', 'vote(d)', 'panel', and 'advisory' returned no matches. There is therefore no evidence in the available documents that an advisory committee was convened, and no passage affirmatively states one was not held; adcom_held is set to false with no verbatim quote available.
